subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Summit — inference at scale?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@edgeai.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps (AI Summit)

Hi Daniel — great meeting you at the AI Summit and thanks for carving out 30 minutes yesterday to walk through your MLP inference workload. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Key takeaways from our call:
- Current workload: ~200 QPS of short-form generation (<= 256 tokens) + a smaller batch reranking job for search.
- Pain: tail latency and burst scaling on a fixed GPU pool; looking to reduce per-token cost without regressing quality.
- Compliance: logs/audit required for EU customers; possible need for VPC/private deployment later.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll attach a short recap + mutual action plan with milestones (attached).
2) If you agree, schedule a 45-min technical deep-dive with your infra lead and our solutions engineer to validate latency SLOs and sizing.
3) I'll pull together ballpark pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted with expected unit economics.

Attachments: redwood-call-recap.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If the above looks good, what does your preferred timeline look like? Early Oct? Mid-Oct?

Thanks — happy to adapt to your procurement cadence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production LLMs

From: Daniel Park <daniel@edgeai.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps (AI Summit)

Hey Marissa — thanks for the recap and the deck. Appreciate the clear plan.

We're still consolidating requirements internally; I pulled in Sarah (cc) from procurement. For next steps: a technical deep-dive makes sense, but can we tentatively aim for the week of Oct 11? Right now we have a couple higher-priority infra tickets that need to land first.

A couple of quick Qs you might be able to answer before we lock a date:
- Do you have an apples-to-apples comparison of Hosted vs Dedicated unit cost at ~200 QPS? Even a rough $/token range would help procurement.
- Any references for customers who migrated from single-node GPU to Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput?

Thanks — will follow up once I sync with the infra team.

Best,
Daniel
Director of Engineering | EdgeAI
daniel@edgeai.ai

- 6–8 week Dedicated evaluation: reserved capacity with short ramp; includes a simple SLA and runbook handover.
